title: e2e/routes.json
description: EPIC-000.9 handoff contract: every shell route exercised by the e2e suite, the axe gate and the qa-visual screenshot manifest (design.md §1.1, spec.md §12). Entries are {path, name, auth, requires?} verbatim per the frozen work-item handoff; `slug` and `heading` are additive conveniences used only by this suite's own scripts.

path.description: The URL path Playwright navigates to, e.g. "/admin".

slug.description: Alphanumeric-only screenshot slug (spec.md §12: "root" for "/"). agentic/scripts/dod.mjs applies `s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '_')` to whatever a manifest lists, so every slug here is already the stable, unambiguous output of that transform.

auth.description: public: renders without a session. session: any signed-in user (redirects to /login otherwise). super_admin: the no-permission state renders for anyone else (AC-11).

chrome.description: Which shell wraps this route (apps/web/src/app.tsx's RouteOutlet): "auth" (AuthShell) issues zero API calls, so its organic state renders with apps/web alone; "app" (AppShell) always calls GET /api/v1/me + /api/v1/instance for the chrome, so its organic state needs apps/api reachable even when the route's own content (a forced state, or /404) does not.

roles.description: v1.1: which personas this route is captured as. Absent means the head alone (every route's original behaviour). A head-only destination lists ["head", "member"] so the screenshot set carries BOTH the real screen and the no-permission state a xodim meets on it -- SPEC §2 is a claim about two people, and a set with only one of them in it cannot show whether it holds.

requires.description: Extra preconditions this route's organic (non-forced) render needs, beyond `auth`.

heading.description: i18n key of the route's organic-state h1/heading, used to assert the real page loaded (not a blank shell) before a screenshot or axe scan.
